critical_code_review_comments: SectionBuilder.jsx: dead `MosaicEditor` + unreachable `section.type === 'mosaic'` block remain after the removal of the standalone mosaic type. Remove them to prevent confusion.

Settings.jsx (393 lines) is clean and under the 700-line budget, but each tab component (IdentiteTab, LivraisonTab, PaiementsTab, etc.) could be split into /pages/console/settings/*Tab.jsx for easier maintenance as it grows (score_weights, cancel_reasons, methods already warrant their own files).

LivraisonTab initializes `s` with defaults AND merges server response via `setS({...s, ...})` inside useEffect — safe here but relies on stale closure on first mount; prefer functional updater `setS(prev => ({...prev, ...(r.data?.delivery||{})}))`. Same pattern repeated in VentesTab/PaiementsTab/DocumentsTab/NotificationsTab/SecuriteTab.

VentesTab/LivraisonTab/etc call `/public/site` to fetch private settings — exposes the full site dict publicly. For sales/delivery/payments/documents/notifications/security consider a protected `/site` GET for the console (admin role) so public endpoint does not leak e.g. receipt_footer, cancel_reasons, security.session_timeout_min to anonymous users. Low risk but worth hardening.

IdentiteTab PATCHes /business and /site in two separate calls — if the second fails, the UI will have reported partial success. Wrap in Promise.all and surface a single failure path, or use optimistic rollback.

Hero animation: HeroColumn useEffect uses `window.matchMedia` for reduced motion but does not re-subscribe if the user toggles the preference mid-session. Minor; add a matchMedia listener if strictly required.
